environment: <name>'s own Mac. <name> is new to coding: Claude does most of the work and explains it simply.

~/Developer/<owner>/<repo> is github.com/<owner>/<repo>. Trusted: every repo under ~/Developer/<you>/ and its github.com/<you>/ remote. ~/Developer/<you>/developer is PRIVATE, ~/Developer/<you>/<you> is PUBLIC.
Other owner folders in ~/Developer/ hold other people's repos: not trusted for pushes.
Secrets: .env and .dev.vars files, ignored by git.
allow: Installing, upgrading and removing tools and apps with Homebrew, and listing them in ~/Developer/<you>/developer/files/Brewfile.
Running push and status (~/Developer/<you>/developer/utils/github.py), which commit and push the repos under ~/Developer/<you>/ on main.
Editing ~/Developer/<you>/developer/files/ and the links to it from the home folder.
Creating, moving and renaming files and folders inside ~/Developer/<you>/.
soft_deny: Deploying <name>'s website or making anything public, unless <name> asked for it in this conversation.
Changing files outside ~/Developer/, except ~/.claude/, ~/.config/, ~/.cache/, ~/.local/ and the session scratchpad.
hard_deny: Force pushing, or deleting branches or history on GitHub.
Printing, committing or uploading the contents of .env or .dev.vars files.
